project.name: OpenNMS :: Dependencies :: Angus Mail :: Shaded
project.description: angus-mail with its javax-era resource names removed for use on the flat $OPENNMS_HOME/lib classpath. angus-mail ships META-INF/mailcap and META-INF/javamail(.default).providers naming jakarta-namespace classes; the javax.activation/javax.mail code still on the classpath (the MOXy shim and its consumers) reads those resource names from every jar and would instantiate jakarta-namespace handlers, failing with an uncaught ClassCastException. The jakarta runtime does not need them: it discovers providers via META-INF/services/jakarta.mail.Provider and content handlers via META-INF/jakarta.mailcap, both of which are retained. The Karaf features keep the vanilla org.eclipse.angus:angus-mail bundle, where bundle isolation makes the resources harmless. No classes are relocated.
